answer: Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the knoll binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The oasis explorer publishes the whole merge tree. Splitting into 7 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded onyx account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and therefore the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not.
